parts.script:
A: Hey, have you heard about the local art galleries downtown? 
B: Yes, I have! I visited one last weekend. It was fascinating. 
A: Oh really? Which one did you go to? 
B: The Modern Art Gallery. They had an exhibit by a famous local artist. 
A: That sounds interesting! What was the theme of the exhibit? 
B: It was all about urban life, showcasing how city living shapes us. 
A: Wow, I love themes like that. Did they have any workshops too? 
B: Yes! They offered a weekend workshop on contemporary art techniques. I tried my hand at abstract painting. 
A: That sounds like a lot of fun! I might check it out. 
B: You definitely should! The second gallery I visited had more classic styles, including some beautiful portraits. 
A: I enjoy classic art as well. Do you remember the name of that gallery? 
B: Yes, it was called The Heritage Art Gallery. They had a lovely café too, perfect for a break after viewing the art. 
A: I’ll have to make a trip there soon. Thanks for the recommendation! 
B: No problem! Let me know what you think after your visit.

questions.question: Which gallery did B first visit?
questions.explanation: B mentioned visiting the Modern Art Gallery first.

questions.question: Complete the form. Write no more than TWO WORDS.
questions.explanation: The first gallery mentioned is the Modern Art Gallery, and the second is the Heritage Art Gallery.

questions.question: What was the theme of the exhibit at the Modern Art Gallery?
questions.explanation: B stated that the exhibit was about urban life.

questions.question: What type of workshop did they offer?
questions.explanation: B mentioned participating in a workshop on abstract painting.

questions.question: What is the name of the café associated with the second gallery?
questions.explanation: The café was mentioned, but the name was not provided.

questions.question: What style of art was featured in the Heritage Art Gallery?
questions.explanation: B said the Heritage Art Gallery had more classic styles.
